values.value: x87 at double precision, rounded to float on every assignment

values.value: exp(q*0.27027027027027023 - 0.15556) * (1 + rms of the low excitation) / filter ratio

values.name: CodecMsx sample rate
values.source: bin header word 4; LTTS7CodecMsx.dll ELQOpenDecoder 0x10002820 picks the ultra-wideband mode (0x100161c0) for 32000/44000/44100

values.name: CodecMsx frame size
values.source: bin header word 5; 848 bits = narrowband 472 + wideband 344 + ultra-wideband 32 (submode bits_per_frame at 0x10015e20, 0x10015fe0, 0x1001610c)

values.name: CodecMsx submodes
values.source: chosen from the frame size 106, not from frame bits: nb_decoder_init 0x10003450, sb_decode 0x10005080

values.name: CodecMsx header
values.value: 31 big-endian words: 0-6 as Codec210, 7 version 2, 8 offset of the first frame from the header, 9 codebook sets, 10-18 bytes per set of each codebook, 19/20 innovation divisors (128), 21-29 codebook entry sizes

values.name: CodecMsx codebooks
values.value: per set: nb LSP 128x10, 16x5, 16x5; nb innovation 64x5; wb LSP 32x8, 8x8; uwb LSP 64x8, 64x8; wb innovation 128x8; a byte per frame names its set
values.source: laid out by 0x10001d40; read by 0x100046d0 (nb LSP), 0x100048a0 (wb), 0x10004a10 (uwb), 0x10001190 (innovation)

values.name: decoder between requests
values.value: one decoder per recordings file; the frame decoded last and the one before are kept and copied from, the frame after the last is decoded by the same decoder, any other frame resets the decoder and decodes from warm-up frames earlier; both frame numbers start at 0xfffffffe
values.source: LTTS7Codec210.dll ELQDecode 0x10004530 -> 0x10004340 (frames at +0x11dc/+0x11e0, set by ELQOpenDecoder 0x100046d3; shift 0x100042f0; reset 0x10004230); LTTS7CodecMsx.dll 0x10002780 -> 0x100024d0 (+0x11e0/+0x11e4, 0x10002a22; shift 0x10002480; reset 0x10002390)

values.name: CodecMsx position past the last frame
values.value: the decoder delay is taken off again
values.source: LTTS7CodecMsx.dll 0x100024f1 compares the frame with the header frame count (+0x11f0, stored by 0x10001dab)

values.name: x87 precision control while decoding
values.value: 53 bits (control word 0x027f; MXCSR 0x1f80/0x1fa0, all exceptions masked)
values.source: read before every ELQDecode request by oracle/loqref.c LOQ_TRACE_DECODE

values.name: decoder exp
values.value: MSVC runtime SSE2 exp: x*64/ln2 rounded with the 1.5*2^52 shifter, ln2/64 in two parts, 64-entry 2^(j/64) table, degree-5 polynomial; ported as x87::exp
values.source: _CIexp LTTS7Codec210.dll 0x10011aec -> 0x100175ee (constants 0x10026fc0-0x10027050, table 0x10027060); LTTS7CodecMsx.dll 0x10006dac -> 0x1000b1ce (table 0x10017980), same code and constants

values.name: decoder SSE2 math flag
values.source: LTTS7Codec210.dll 0x100300cc set by 0x10015195 (CPUID SSE2 and the OS check 0x10014ff0), LTTS7CodecMsx.dll 0x1001c184 by 0x10007fd9; logged as `S` lines by LOQ_TRACE_DECODE

values.name: decoder sqrt
values.value: fsqrt at the caller's precision control (the correctly rounded double square root)

values.name: output resampler

values.value: 8192-tap wing, 256 per sample, lowpass 0.90, Kaiser beta 9, max 32767
values.source: tables 0x1007ad88 (Imp) and 0x1007ed88 (ImpD); regenerated value for value (codec::tests::large_filter_is_the_dlls)
